evidenceGrounding.methodologyNote: Gold evidence recall and field-to-evidence association accuracy are heuristic annotation-matching metrics comparing extracted evidence text against gold expected snippets. Verbatim precision (100%) applies strictly to the attached quotes verifying they appear verbatim in the source transcript at exact character offsets. Grounding coverage is 84.21% (48/57 fields) because abstract category classifications do not carry quotation spans.

latency.coldWorkerInitDescription: createWorker() includes worker setup, core loading, language loading and initialization.
latency.warmWorkerInitDescription: Warm reinitialization reuses the existing worker.
latency.languageModelPoolLoadDescription: The current worker-pool timing measures three sequential worker creations (ben, eng, ben+eng), each including worker setup, core loading, language loading and initialization.
latency.scopeDescription: Per-document warm pipeline timing excludes worker and language-model setup.
